name: io.github.SathvikNayak123/trace-replay
description: Deterministic agent-run replay: resume a recorded ctx-capture trace from any step with a modified prompt/model/params and see what changes, with everything before that step held constant.
title: trace-replay

packageArguments.name: --db
packageArguments.description: ctx-capture SQLite trace database path to read/write traces from

packageArguments.name: --replay-db
packageArguments.description: SQLite database path for replay-run bookkeeping (status, config, cost, divergences)

packageArguments.name: --entrypoints
packageArguments.description: 'module:attr' pointing at a dict[str, Entrypoint] (agent_name -> harness entrypoint) implementing the integration contract

environmentVariables.name: TRACE_REPLAY_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required only when running with --transport http
